heading: Monitor
bottomHtml: A monitor is a display device that outputs visual information from a computer or other electronic devices. It is used to view images, videos, and data in real time. Monitors come in various sizes, resolutions, and panel types, including LED, LCD, and OLED, offering different viewing experiences. They are commonly used for tasks such as gaming, office work, content creation, and multimedia consumption. Key features to consider when choosing a monitor include screen size, resolution (such as Full HD, 4K, or Ultra-Wide), refresh rate, and response time for a smooth and clear viewing experience.
